interface.shortDescription: Python project tooling: uv, typed config trees, loguru, path centralization
interface.longDescription: Skills for writing the code. Drive Python projects through uv, collapse scattered settings into one typed pydantic config tree, route all diagnostics through loguru including third-party stdlib loggers, treat public interfaces as typed contracts, and keep filesystem paths in a single config instead of inline literals.
defaultPrompt: Set this project up with uv.
Collapse these scattered settings into one typed config.
Replace these print calls with structured logging.
